title: Reading from a disk
question: The same read(), of a file on ext4: where do the bytes come from the first time?

stops.note: The name is not in the dentry cache yet: ext4 reads the directory's block from the disk to find it.
The page cache, as for a file in memory; but the page is not there yet...
...so ext4 finds where the file's data is on the disk (its extents), and reads it into the page...
...through the block layer: a request to the disk, /dev/loop0, whose blocks are a file in memory. Then the bytes are copied out.
